headline: Monarch Butterflies Stage Remarkable Comeback in Western New York
meta_description: A local observer reports dozens of monarch butterflies and caterpillars in Western New York in 2026, up dramatically from fewer than a dozen two years prior.
summary_short: After spotting fewer than a dozen monarch butterflies two years ago, a Western New York observer has witnessed a dramatic resurgence in 2026.
body:
A local observer in Western New York is celebrating a remarkable turnaround for monarch butterflies in the region. After seeing fewer than a dozen of the insects just two years ago, 2026 has brought dozens of monarchs—along with their caterpillars—to the area.

The shift marks a striking recovery for a species that has faced steep population declines over recent decades. The return of both adult butterflies and caterpillars suggests conditions in Western New York may be improving for monarch reproduction and survival, offering a glimmer of hope for conservation efforts across the region.
quick_facts: Fewer than a dozen monarchs spotted two years ago
